sections.body: Chef & Mixologist is a pure vegetarian restaurant and cafe in Sreebhumi, Lake Town, Kolkata. The menu spans North Indian, Chinese and pan-Asian dishes, with Continental, Italian and Mexican favourites, and a long list of mocktails and beverages. There is live music, a private dining room for groups, parking with valet, and wheelchair access. Jain-friendly and kitty-party menus are part of what we do.
